Bug_Title: "@Controller" classes that use "@SessionAttributes" must call "setComplete" on their "SessionStatus" objects
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by using the @SessionAttributes annotation without calling setComplete on the SessionStatus object in any of the request mapping methods.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method of the HelloWorld class, which internally calls the greet method. Since the greet method does not call setComplete on the SessionStatus object, the bug is triggered.
